data.one_liner: CLI tool to package Flutter Linux release builds into Debian (.deb) packages
data.what_it_does: Packages compiled Flutter Linux release binaries into standard Debian (.deb) installers using configuration defined in debian.yaml and pubspec.yaml. It handles desktop entry integration, app icons, maintainer scripts, and skeleton configuration files. It also provides tools to inspect and detect shared library dependencies for the package control file.
use_when: Distributing a Flutter Linux desktop application as a .deb package for Ubuntu, Debian, or derivatives
Automating Linux desktop packaging in CI/CD pipelines
Need to bundle maintainer scripts, desktop icons, and config files with a Linux Flutter app
avoid_when: Building for non-Linux platforms or package formats other than Debian (e.g., Snap, Flatpak, AppImage)
Looking for an in-app runtime Flutter library rather than a build/packaging CLI tool
strengths: Simplifies .deb package creation using a straightforward YAML configuration
Includes a dependency detection mode to identify required system libraries
Supports maintainer scripts (preinst, postinst, prerm, postrm) and custom skeleton directories
weaknesses: Limited exclusively to Debian-based packaging workflows
Requires manual pre-compilation of the Linux release bundle via `flutter build linux`
data.setup_notes: Must be activated globally via Dart (`dart pub global activate flutter_to_debian`) and requires a `debian/debian.yaml` configuration alongside desktop entry files.
